description: Reproduction preparation labels. Automation prepares evidence only; owners decide the result after manual review.

labels.name: repro-requested
labels.description: A maintainer requested safe reproduction preparation

labels.name: repro-in-progress
labels.description: A metadata check is running; investigation or fix work has not started

labels.name: repro-confirmed
labels.description: A maintainer reproduced the reported behavior manually

labels.name: repro-not-reproduced
labels.description: A maintainer did not observe the behavior; the report remains available for follow-up

labels.name: repro-blocked
labels.description: More information or a stable report revision is needed before manual reproduction

labels.name: repro-needs-review
labels.description: Ready for a maintainer to attempt manual reproduction; no reporter action is needed
